[in both W.Ps] Special Government Pleader  COMMON ORDER
By consent of both sides, these Writ Petitions are disposed of at the stage of admission itself.

2. These Writ Petitions are filed to consider petitioners' representation dated 08.08.2023 and pay the petitioners difference amount of Rs.20,565/- per cent to their acquired lands with all other benefits in the light of the order ________ https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis W.P. Nos.12630 &
12635 of 2024 passed by the Hon'ble Supreme Court of India in Civil Appeal Nos.9531 & 9532 of 2018 fixing compensation at the rate of Rs.50,000/- per cent with all other benefits as per Land Acquisition Act and to deposit the difference amount of Rs.20,565/- per cent for petitioners'
acquired lands with all other benefits as per Land Acquisition Act into LAOP Nos.1424 of 2008 and 1428 of 2008 respectively on the file of Principal Subordinate Judge, at Kancheepuram.
3. Heard the learned counsel for the petitioners and the learned Special Government Pleader appearing for the respondents and perused the materials available on record.
4. The case of the petitioners is that the land of the petitioners have been acquired by the Government for the purpose of effecting improvements to Chembarambakkam Surplus Water Course and widening the channel under improvement of Chennai City Water Ways Scheme and compensation has also been awarded.
As higher compensation has been fixed to the similar land owners, the petitioners' made representations dated 09.08.2023 to the respondents.
However, the same has not been considered by them.
Hence, the present Writ Petitions.
